# Links

## Wikilinks

- Plain: [[Target]]
- With alias: [[Target|the target note]]
- To a heading: [[Target#Second section]]
- To a block: [[Target#^key-point]]
- Same note heading: [[#Markdown links]]
- Path: [[notes/Project plan]]
- Ambiguous name, resolved by folder distance: [[Duplicate]]
- Unresolved (dimmed, creates the note on click): [[Missing note]]
- An alias is not a file name, so this stays unresolved, as in Obsidian:
  [[Home]] (typing `[[Ho` suggests `[[Welcome|Home]]` instead)

## Markdown links

- Relative: [Target](Target.md)
- Encoded path: [Project plan](notes/Project%20plan.md)
- Heading fragment: [second section](Target.md#second-section)

## External links

- Web: https://example.com and [Example](https://example.com)
- Mail: [Write](mailto:test@example.com)
- Another application (asks first): [Obsidian](obsidian://open?vault=Test)
- A PDF opens with the PDF viewer: [Sample PDF](attachments/sample.pdf)
